en.headline: sogeisetsu opens 3 issues on openchamber, 2 commits to personal repo
en.summary: On 2026-10-03, sogeisetsu made 2 commits to their personal repository and opened 3 issues on openchamber/openchamber. The issues cover a test file still passing after API removal, a UI icon conflict between command palette and sidebar, and outdated multi-run documentation referencing a removed sidebar button. Two of the issues received automated triage comments from openchamber-bot.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu 在 openchamber 提交 3 个 issue，个人仓库 2 次提交
zh.summary: 2026-10-03，sogeisetsu 在个人仓库完成 2 次提交，并在 openchamber/openchamber 上提交了 3 个 issue。这些 issue 涉及 API 移除后测试文件仍通过、命令面板与侧边栏图标冲突，以及多运行文档仍引用已移除的侧边栏按钮。其中两个 issue 收到了 openchamber-bot 的自动分诊评论。
